data.name: The Diamond Adventures
data.detailed_description:
Do you remember how it began?

July 14, 2012. It started with one video. And from one video came another and another and another… And with those passing videos, the time, too, began to pass. But time goes too fast… Doesn’t it? Don’t you ever wish you could go back and relive it? From the real beginning? What if you could experience the magic of those memories again? And escape the present to do so… Would you?

The Diamond Adventures is a multi-genre, single-player adventure game charting DanTDM’s journey through every era of his career, from TCGs and tours to his varying labs and offices, from early music to modern day series.

Upon discovering a mysterious machine in his basement, Dan is pulled back through time into the different key eras of his career. Meeting with old and forgotten friends and foes, Dan will need to beat minigames and explore these old memories while making his way back to the present. However, the closer Dan gets to returning to his family, the more these old memories seem to distort.

The game blends 2D and 3D aesthetics through a variety of levels and minigames, from platformers to horror gameplay, warping through time and space. Endless genres. Endless possibilities.

ANIMANDan - 2010

Discover humble beginnings in Shelf Stacking, a 3D supermarket simulator.

Play an all original TCG with a 60 card deck.

4 ANIMA types, 10 Character cards and 10 Animator cards, all with individual art.

Custom Adventures - 2012-2015

Meet your favourite characters like Dr. Trayaurus, Grim, Craig and many more…

Relive old adventures, on a three-act quest from The Lab to a Lair.

A 2D pixelated turn-based strategy rpg with different zones, interspersed with a variety of puzzles and minigames.

Mirror Tour - 2016

A fictionalised stage show with a twist - mirrors, sailboats and pirates!

A brand new cast of original characters takes the audience and player on a meta journey.

Reimagined minigames from an endless runner to a button-mashing duel.

Locked Down at Daniel’s - 2017-2020

A 3D survival game. Can you withstand Pinky’s attacks with just a torch?

Explore a nightmarish house, pursued by something dark…

All your favourite horror styles in one shifting level. Not everything is as it seems.

REDACTED - 2021-Present

A massive nostalgic mashup of a final level.

Concludes with an epilogue that honours all TeamTDM.

Unlocks the After-Game Treasure Room for endless minigame replays.

DanTDM is taken back through the old eras of his YouTube journey, allying with old friends and facing old foes as he makes his way through the memories into the present day.
